name: Discord messages (experimental)
description: Receive ordinary messages from one configured Discord server channel through a bot. Uses chunked external-message intake. No outgoing Discord messages or voice support. Live service compatibility remains unverified.

settings.label: Server ID
settings.description: Numeric ID of the Discord server. Enable Discord Developer Mode to copy it.

settings.label: Channel ID
settings.description: Numeric ID of the one text channel to receive. Threads and direct messages are excluded.
